subject: HelixHealth: sudden tail-latency increase on model v8.2 - mitigation request
messages:

Cc: Tom Saito <tom.saito@helixhealth.com>, Procurement <alice.procure@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: production latency - noticeable tail for v8.2 since deploy

Hi Evelyn,

We started seeing a steady increase in 99th/99.9th percentile latency across our critical endpoints after the v8.2 rollout at ~03:00 UTC. 95th is fine, but tails are spiking and a couple of customer-facing flows timed out today (~1:12pm PT). This is affecting confirmation email generation (time-sensitive).

I've attached a zipped log bundle and a small sample request/response that exhibits the issue (helix-tail-logs-20261213.zip). Can you confirm whether this is related to the new quantization path you mentioned in the release notes? We need an ETA on mitigation and whether you can do a targeted revert for our traffic.

Tom Saito
Head of Platform Ops
HelixHealth
ops@helixhealth.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: production latency - noticeable tail for v8.2 since deploy

Thanks for the logs, Tom — I appreciate the quick heads up.

Short answer: we believe the tail is tied to the new quantized execution path in v8.2 when sequences exceed ~1024 tokens on certain prompt shapes. Soojin and Marcus are pulling metrics now; we'll validate the exact trigger.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Start a limited canary rollback of HelixHealth traffic to v8.1 (no config change on your side) while we continue to investigate.
- If you approve, we can route 10% of traffic back to v8.1 within 30 minutes and observe p95/p99/p99.9.
- We'll prepare an SLA exception form for temporary credit/mitigation while we root-cause.

Please confirm you want us to proceed with the partial rollback. If you prefer a different cadence (e.g., 25% first), tell us now. We'll also start collecting traces for the exact prompt shapes.

Evelyn Hart
Account Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.ai

Attachment: sla-exception-request-helix.pdf (draft)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelixHealth Ops <ops@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: production latency - noticeable tail for v8.2 since deploy

Summary of early findings (quick triage):
- Correlation: 99.9th spikes correspond to requests that hit the quantized fast-path but then experience a fallback to a slower kernel on a small subset of sequence lengths (~1024-1150 tokens).
- Root cause hypothesis: a rare cache eviction pattern in the KV cache combined with a quantized kernel switch causes several extra micro-batches to be executed, amplifying tail latency under bursty traffic.
- A/B test data (Helix sample): routing 12% of requests to v8.1 reduced p99.9 from ~1.4s to ~350ms for that sample set.

Recommended immediate mitigation (engineering approved):
1) Approve staged canary rollback for HelixHealth to v8.1 at 10% -> 50% -> full if tails improve. Rollback will be at routing layer only, no user config change.
2) Enable a temporary route-level KV-cache pin for HelixHealth's most common prompt shapes (reduces risk of eviction).
3) If rollback is insufficient within 90 minutes, escalate to a short patch rollforward with a guard (kernel-level fix) — estimated 4-6 hours to ship and validate.

I'll coordinate with Marcus to schedule the rollback windows. We should also offer Helix a temporary SLA credit for the impacted window; Evelyn, can you start the exception paperwork?

Soojin Lee
SRE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
